name: PESTEC
recent: Pestec 近期围绕与山东电力设备有限公司（SPECO）的诉讼与清盘呈请展开，公司已取得禁令阻止对方执行企业担保，并称该清盘呈请的撤回意向已由子公司律师传达。同时，公司委任前砂拉越警察总监 Mancha Ata 进入董事会，并在 9 月 9 日举行第 15 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
notable: 公司取得高等法院禁令，阻止中国供应商 SPECO 执行企业担保。
公司委任前砂拉越警察总监 Mancha Ata 为董事。
第 15 届常年股东大会所有决议以投票方式通过。
risks: 公司面临 SPECO 提出的清盘呈请，涉及金额约 1000 万美元。
公司涉及多项重大诉讼。
董事及大股东 Datuk Seri (Dr.) Subramaniam Pillai 在 10 月有多笔股权变动申报。
earnings: 截至 2025 年 3 月 31 日止期间，公司营收为 8791 万令吉，净亏损 3832.3 万令吉，净亏损率为 43.6%。

Pestec appoints former Sarawak police commissioner Mancha Ata to its board
Pestec Clarifies To Bursa On US$10 Million Winding Up Petition Served By SPECO

Pestec says unaware of winding-up petition until Bursa notification, disputes Chinese supplier's claim
PESTEC Served With Winding Up Petition, Disputes Validity
Pestec Secures Interim Injunction Against SPECO Over Disputed US$10 Million Corporate Guarantee
Pestec wins fresh injunction against Speco

recent_en: Pestec has recently been dealing with litigation and a winding-up petition from Shandong Power Equipment Co Ltd (SPECO); the company obtained an injunction to restrain enforcement of a corporate guarantee and said its unit's solicitors conveyed an intention to withdraw the winding-up petition. Meanwhile, it appointed former Sarawak police commissioner Mancha Ata to its board and held its 15th AGM on 9 September, where all resolutions were passed.
notable_en: The company obtained a High Court injunction restraining Chinese supplier SPECO from enforcing a corporate guarantee.
The company appointed former Sarawak police commissioner Mancha Ata as a director.
All resolutions at the 15th AGM were passed by poll.
risks_en: The company faces a winding-up petition from SPECO involving about US$10 million.
The company is involved in multiple material litigation cases.
Director and substantial shareholder Datuk Seri (Dr.) Subramaniam Pillai filed several changes in interest in October.
earnings_en: For the period ended 31 March 2025, revenue was MYR 87.91 million and net loss was MYR 38.323 million, with a net loss margin of 43.6%.
